title.zh-TW: 好友訂閱後，好友與邀請人各得 5 枚 M 幣
title.en: Friend and inviter each get 5 M-Coins when the friend subscribes

text.zh-TW: 限時：加入 Max 年繳，好友與邀請人各得共 10 枚 M 幣。5 枚與 10 枚都取自平台分享文案；官方條款為準。
text.en: Limited time: with a Max annual plan, friend and inviter each get 10 M-Coins in total. Both the 5 and the 10 are from the share text; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會前往 MacroMicro 的訂閱頁，邀請碼 ML8HQ5 已在網址中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it leads to the MacroMicro subscription page, with invite code ML8HQ5 already in the address).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示登入或註冊會員，選擇方案並完成訂閱。
steps.en: Log in or register as the page directs, then choose a plan and subscribe.

steps.zh-TW: 若頁面有欄位要求邀請碼，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入 ML8HQ5。
steps.en: If a field asks for an invite code, enter ML8HQ5 exactly as shown, including capitalization.

steps.zh-TW: 訂閱後確認 M 幣是否入帳；數量與期限以官方公告為準。
steps.en: After subscribing, check whether the M-Coins arrive; amounts and deadlines follow the official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 透過邀請碼 ML8HQ5 訂閱 MacroMicro 財經M平方，依分享文案，好友訂閱後雙方各得 5 枚 M 幣。
intro.en: Subscribe to MacroMicro with invite code ML8HQ5; per the share text, both sides get 5 M-Coins when a friend subscribes.

description.zh-TW:
MacroMicro 財經M平方是台灣的經濟與市場數據訂閱服務，提供圖表、數據與研究內容。本頁連結已包含邀請碼 ML8HQ5（網址中的 rc 參數），會前往官方訂閱頁。

依分享文案，好友訂閱後雙方各得 5 枚 M 幣；限時加入 Max 年繳，雙方各得共 10 枚 M 幣。實際內容、數量與期限以官方公告為準。
description.en:
MacroMicro (財經M平方) is a Taiwan-based subscription service for economic and market data, charts and research content. The invite code ML8HQ5 is already part of the referral link on this page (the rc parameter), which opens the official subscription page.

According to the share text, when a friend subscribes both sides get 5 M-Coins, and for a limited time a Max annual plan gives each side 10 M-Coins in total. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow MacroMicro's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: ML8HQ5 是網址中的 rc 參數，分享文案沒有說明它的名稱；訂閱頁是否有輸入欄位沒有確認，也沒有實際訂閱測試邀請碼是否被接受。限時活動的分享文案沒有寫結束日。內容為資訊性質，不構成投資建議，投資決策與風險請自行評估。
notes.en: ML8HQ5 is the rc parameter in the link, and the share text does not name it; whether the subscription page has an entry field was not confirmed, and nobody subscribed to test whether the code is accepted. The share text gives no end date for the limited-time offer. The content is information, not investment advice; assess your own decisions and risks.

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只說雙方各得 5 枚 M 幣（Max 年繳限時共 10 枚），沒有說明 M 幣的用途、期限或是否可退款；本站沒有讀到官方說明頁，實際以 MacroMicro 官方公告為準。
a.en: The share text only says both sides get 5 M-Coins (10 in total for a limited-time Max annual plan) and does not explain what M-Coins can be used for, when they expire, or whether they are refundable; this site did not read the official help page, so MacroMicro’s official announcements prevail.
